summary: The mathematics is right and the numerics reproduce exactly. G = H*||F_x||^2 is a correct theorem. The nine-real-dimensional family of flat-invariant metrics is right, and so is the drop to three under the characters. B1654's premise is false. The arc's own instrument reproduces every stored number bit for bit on six classes, and an independent implementation sharing no code agrees on eight. Four corrections block banking: (1) the consequence for P-510 and Step B is unstated, and the headline invites the inference 'no new freedom', which is false; (2) B1654's error is mislocated and incomplete; (3) the dependents list is incomplete; (4) the claim line's 'only under the cover typing' is false.

blocking.item: 1. The consequence for P-510 and Step B is unstated, and the headline invites the wrong inference.
blocking.evidence: audit/drafts/final_attack/P510_RULING.md, point 2: 'T-NORM computed on the evaluator ... Until it is computed, "no new freedom" is not established'. Its consequence line: 'none, if T-NORM holds'. B1822 shows G = H*||F_x||^2 with H free in Herm_3^+ under the flat structure: 9 real parameters, 8 per field modulo the scale that drops out of every stored output. That is 40 across Q, u, d, L and e if each field's H is independent, or 8 if one H serves all fields. So 'no new freedom' is false as a fact of the frame. T-NORM holds only because H = I is chosen. The arc's REPORT verdict token 'T-NORM HOLDS' and FINDINGS' 'so the census stands' feed straight into P-510's conditional as 'no new freedom'. The freedom is load-bearing (referee, census_basis.py, on a frame-built Y that is not a census row). A 10% weight on the k mode moves the ratios by 0.007 decades and |V| by 4e-4. A 0.05 (j, k) mixing moves |V| by 9e-3. The diagonal-SU(2) democratic member I + 0.1(J - I) moves the ratios by 0.045 decades and |V| by 0.08. A scale 3.7*I changes nothing (5e-16).
blocking.fix: State in FINDINGS section 4 and in the claim line that P-510's pre-seal condition is met only by declaring H = I part of FR-FIB. That declaration is CHOSEN and must be counted on Step B's card with the size of the freedom it closes: Herm_3^+ per field, 8 real parameters per field modulo scale. Say that 'no new freedom' is not established and is false for the flat structure. Replace the verdict token 'T-NORM HOLDS' with 'T-NORM HOLDS IN THE CHOSEN METRIC H = I; NOT FORCED BY THE FLAT STRUCTURE'. Scope 'the census stands' to 'as a census of FR-FIB with H = I'. Amend P510_RULING's consequence line at the same landing.

blocking.item: 2. B1654's error is mislocated and incomplete, and that would make the dated notes on P-146 and P-109 wrong.
blocking.evidence: The reasoning is in frontier/B1654_*/PREREGISTRATION.md section 11 (lines 158-164). FINDINGS line 108 only summarises it. Section 11 has three steps. (a) 'No invariant pairing joins sections of different flat bundles' is false for the matter: every invariant form is X_pq = H_pq C_p C_q^-1 (referee residual 4e-16, real dimension 9). (b) 'The discrete charge forbids it' is valid only if the characters are imposed as a symmetry of the generation index. That is a typing; it gives dimension 3, H diagonal. (c) 'The diagonal is ||C_pF||^2 = ||F||^2, since C_p is unitary' assumes one normalisation for all three generations, which (b) does not supply: (b) leaves three free scales. So even the most charitable reading proves H diagonal, not H proportional to I. FINDINGS section 4 puts the whole error in the cross terms ('different but isomorphic bundles admit cross terms'), which implies that excluding the mixing restores ||F||^2*I_3. It does not. This matters directly for P-146. Its closing note dismissed the web seat's diagonal weight (kappa on the k mode) with 'a weight on one mode needs a metric the zero modes do not carry'. H = diag(1, 1, kappa) is admitted both by the flat structure and by typing (b).
blocking.fix: Quote section 11 in full and grade each step as above. P-146's note: the weight on one mode is admitted, and is excluded only by a typing that forces H proportional to I. P-109 and P-112's note: the fence ('no kinetic mixing') is met only under a typing that kills the mixing (characters on the index, a product metric, the cover typing), not by the flat structure. Also record that B1654's sentence is TRUE for the Higgs channels: their four kernels carry the four distinct V4 characters (referee check), so they are rank-one and mutually non-isomorphic. The sentence fails only for the matter's rank-2 bundles.

blocking.item: 4. The claim line's 'forced by Schur only under the cover typing' is false, and FINDINGS' 'CHOSEN unless the cover typing is derived' is too narrow.
blocking.evidence: The arc's own REPORT, theorem (e), gives a second route: a product metric with an irreducible generation symmetry. The referee computed the real dimension of the invariant hermitian forms on C^2 (x) C^3 under each typing: flat holonomy alone 9; plus the characters on the generation index 3; product h_V (x) h_M 3; the diagonal SU(2) (2 (x) adjoint), in which the frame's holonomy lies (residual 0), 2, restricting to H = alpha I + beta J; SU(2) x SO(3) acting separately 1; the characters plus the Q8 outer automorphism of order 3 (the 2T element (1+i+j+k)/2 with the cyclic block permutation) 1, and that automorphism without the characters 3; the cover typing 1 (the arc's). So H proportional to I is forced by at least three typings. It is not forced by the frame's own diagonal SU(2), which admits a democratic mixing. That last fact is REPORT (c), and it is missing from FINDINGS.
blocking.fix: Claim line: 'forced only by a typing that gives the generation index a symmetry (the cover's deck group; an irreducible generation symmetry; the characters with the order-3 automorphism), not by the flat structure, the characters alone, a product metric or the diagonal SU(2) (a democratic family)'. Put this typing table in FINDINGS section 3.

non_blocking: The 1170-configuration computation checks an identity. In the cover typing the Gram matrix for ANY constant blocks is ||F||^2 * (1/2) tr(C_p^dagger C_q), the R^4 Gram of the blocks. The referee reproduced this for random unit-quaternion triples to <= 1.2e-15 on 8 classes, and found the cover-averaged F F^dagger = (||F||^2/2) I_2 to <= 1.2e-15. So the off-diagonal vanishes exactly when the blocks are orthonormal quaternions, and in H = I on E it is zero by definition. It can fail only through a code or quadrature fault. Present it as a check of the character structure and of the quadrature, not as evidence for T-NORM. Also write '1170 configurations in 306 integrated twist classes' in FINDINGS. The class reduction is exact: a -> a+1 leaves F unchanged, and b -> b+1 multiplies F by e^{2 pi i a} diag(1, -1), which conjugates the Gram by diag(1, -1, 1) and leaves every modulus unchanged.

The cover typing's consistency with the frame's Yukawa is not examined. E' = C/2L has four punctures. A deck-symmetric Higgs, sitting at all four, imposes the selection rule chi_a chi_b chi_S = 1 on Y, which the census's single-puncture residue coupling does not have. A Higgs at one puncture breaks the deck symmetry that the kinetic argument uses. Any derivation of the cover typing (P-531) must say where the Higgs sits; otherwise it changes the census as well as fixing H. (Referee's reasoning; not computed.)

Seen first. P-087 and P-062 hold the SM seat's W49 (2026-10-13): W = rho_Q (x) M, 'one zero mode three times', and chi_p (x) rho_Q isomorphic to rho_Q through the quaternion units. That states the isomorphism two days before B1654 section 1.11. In W49's own picture the metric on M is a free hermitian form, so the nine-dimensional family is immediate. Cite W49 (cites_seat), and let P-062 ('engaged too little: W49') record this engagement. B1600's w21_check.py, line 75 ('if p == q'), computes W21's Hodge-Riemann form blockwise, so W49's M3 '2 I_3 in the parity basis' was block-diagonal by construction. REPORT notes this; FINDINGS does not. P-146's S129 remark was 'firewalled until checked under seal'; B1654 section 1.11 was 'by hand, no cell'; the 2026-10-22 triage nonetheless closed P-109, P-112 and P-146 on it. That deserves one line. The topic-sweep VERDICT line is marked 'at landing' and must still be run.

Name collision: THEOREM_REGISTRY's T-NORM (row 29: N(lambda_m) = -1, B469) is a different theorem, and this arc's claim line uses 'T-NORM' bare. Write 'T-NORM (the matter's kinetic normalisation, P-146/P-525)'.

FINDINGS section 1 says 'the physical L2 metric is the flat one'. The double periodicity of |F|^2 fixes the bundle metric (no Gaussian factor), not the area measure on E, and the fibre has a canonical hyperbolic structure (B1667). The theorem holds for any L-invariant density rho, with G = H * int rho|F|^2. Say so: T-NORM's form does not depend on the measure.

Wording. 'T-NORM is exact for the modes' should read 'the modes contribute one scalar per field; T-NORM holds iff H is proportional to I'. 'In the metric the census uses' should read 'in the metric for which the census's plain SVD is physical (exactly H proportional to I, per field)'. The census computes no metric; its SVD in {C_p F_x} x {C_q F_y} is physical iff K_L and K_R are proportional to I. The referee confirmed that the frame's coupling() is the bilinear (C_a F_x)^T eps S (C_b F_y) of independently computed modes, to 1.6e-14. So the arc's reading of the census is right.

Labels (rule of 2026-10-29): give the claim its labels with scope. G = H ||F_x||^2: FORCED within FR-FIB's flat structure (B1822). The Herm_3^+ family: ADMITTED. H = I: CHOSEN (FR-FIB's typing). Also disclose that the arc was computed unsealed (the tool was not committed before the run); this is harmless here because the outcome is a theorem.

Banking hygiene. REPORT.json's 'files' paths point into audit/verify_tnorm/, which is gitignored. build_report.py and REPORT_prose.json were not carried into the arc's verification/ folder (the four files that were carried are byte-identical to the originals). A test lock asserting the mathematics is owed, as B1819-B1821 have: the 9/3/1 counts, X_pq = H_pq C_p C_q^-1, and A_cov = (||F||^2/2) I_2 on one class.

Literature. The magnetised-torus source is named 'e.g.' with no pages read. It is not leaned on, and FINDINGS should say so. The magnetised-torus analogue of a typing that forces T-NORM (a non-abelian discrete flavour symmetry acting irreducibly on the generations, e.g. Abe, Choi, Kobayashi and Ohki, 2009) is a pointer only; it was not read on this bench.
Scope. The arc reads the modes the census uses and does not show that they exhaust the holomorphic sections of V_x (x) L_chi_p. That is the right scope for P-525, but it should be stated.

The size bound in REPORT (mass ratios move by at most sqrt(cond K_L cond K_R)) was checked by the referee on four kinetic metrics; every change fell within it. The statement that the CKM entries have no uniform bound is correct.
rerun: (a) The arc's tnorm.py, run from a byte-identical copy (sha256 4720915f20af...), executing gram_job and structure on six twist classes. These were the zero line of Q at i; e/Q (2/5, 3/10) at 0.35+2.75i; u order 7 at 0.85+3.45i; L order 12 at 0.3+6i; d order 9 at 0.05+2.05i; and Q order 4 (0, 1/4) at 0.3+6i, the 0.99985 class. Every stored number was reproduced exactly: the maximum |stored - rerun| is 0.0. The invariant-metric counts 9/3/1 were reproduced. (b) An independent implementation sharing no code with the arc. It uses product-formula thetas (checked against mpmath.jtheta to 1.8e-14), four puncture-centred cells each cut into four apex-singular Duffy triangles, and the cover as the union of the four centred cells, with the integrand evaluated at the actual z (no transformation law used). On eight classes: ||F||^2 agrees with the arc to <= 7e-13 relative at Im tau <= 4. At Im tau = 6 my n = 48 is under-resolved (4e-8), but at n = 96-160 it converges to the arc's n = 64 value to about 6e-15 on the 0.99985 class. The single-cell entries, including 0.999852509403, agree to <= 6e-12. The sign flip I(P+1) = chi_p chi_q(1) I(P) holds to <= 4.4e-16. The cover-averaged F F^dagger equals (||F||^2/2) I_2, and the frame's cover Gram equals I, both to <= 1.2e-15. The monodromy r(z+1) = -r(z), r(z+tau) r(z) = -1 and the periodicity of |F|^2 hold to <= 1.1e-13. The single-cell value 0.99985 is explained: A_cell/||F||^2 has eigenvalues 7.4e-5 and 0.99993, because the mode's doublet direction is nearly constant over the cell, and the cell Gram is tr(C_p^dagger C_q A_cell). It is a section of a non-trivial flat line bundle, not a kinetic coefficient. (c) The census's coupling() and bil() equal the bilinear of the referee's modes to 1.6e-14 on 20 random configurations. (d) T-NORM is load-bearing; see blocking item 1. All runs used one process at a time, nice 10 and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, under three minutes of CPU in total.
theorem_check: G = H ||F_x||^2 is correct, proved by hand and checked numerically. V_x, with monodromy e^{i alpha} QI and e^{i beta} QJ and -1 around the puncture, is irreducible for every twist; the U(1) phases set by the line cancel. Since C_p rho C_p^-1 = chi_p rho, V_x (x) L_chi_p is isomorphic to V_x. By Schur, Hom_flat(V (x) L_chi_q, V (x) L_chi_p) = C C_p C_q^-1, so every holonomy-invariant hermitian form on the direct sum is X_pq = H_pq C_p C_q^-1 with H hermitian, positive iff H > 0. On psi_p = C_p F_x the Gram is H_pq ||F_x||^2, because C_p^dagger C_p C_q^-1 C_q = 1. Referee's computation: real dimension 9, every invariant form of that shape (residual 4e-16), and all of Herm_3 realised. The commutant of the holonomy is isomorphic to GL_3(C), and its orbit of the standard metric is the whole family (H = c^dagger c). So the drop to 3 under the characters is right: H is diagonal with three free scales, which is not T-NORM. The other typings are listed in blocking item 4. In the cover typing, T-NORM holds iff the blocks are orthonormal quaternions, which {j, i, k} are. The theorem holds for every tau and line, and for any L-invariant area density.
b1654: B1654's reasoning is PREREGISTRATION.md section 11; FINDINGS line 108 summarises it. Graded step by step. (a) 'No invariant pairing joins sections of different flat bundles' is FALSE for the matter. The bundles differ as matrices but are isomorphic (chi_p (x) rho_Q is isomorphic to rho_Q, already W49's statement in P-087, 2026-10-13), and C_p C_q^-1 is an invariant pairing. The sentence is TRUE for the Higgs channels, whose kernels carry the four distinct V4 characters. (b) 'The discrete charge forbids it' holds only if the characters are imposed as a symmetry of the generation index; that is a typing, giving H diagonal. (c) 'The diagonal is ||C_pF||^2 = ||F||^2' assumes one normalisation for the three generations, and under (b) the three scales are free. (d) The conclusion ||F||^2 I_3 is exact for H proportional to I. The 'physical, non-twisted metric' does not rescue the argument. The basis in which the blocks are QJ, QI, QK is fixed only up to the commutant (GL_3(C)), whose orbit of the standard metric is the whole family. Requiring a product metric gives (b)'s three scales, not I_3. What B1654 should have said: 'The Higgs channels live in four non-isomorphic flat line bundles, so no invariant pairing joins them. The generations live in V (x) L_chi_p, which are isomorphic, so the flat structure admits a hermitian form H on the generation space (nine real parameters). The matter's L2 metric is H ||F||^2, and ||F||^2 I_3 is the choice H = I, unless a typing forces it (the cover's deck symmetry, or an irreducible generation symmetry).' The arc is right that the reason is false. Its account of why is incomplete, and with it its notes on P-146 and P-109 (blocking item 2).
